text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need a lightweight observability canvas for per-model/route SLOs (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Goal: usable in Console -> Route view + Alerts. Anyone from runtime/infra free?
Priya Nair: +1. Main question: whats the authoritative source for TTFT? runtime emits time_to_first_token_ms but there are buffering delays in proxy.
Marco Ruiz: runtime here — we emit `first_token_latency_ms` and `token_emit_rate` per request with labels {route, model, variant}. Proxy adds up to 30ms jitter. We can add `proxy_edge_delay_ms` too.
Samira Patel: Eng-SRE: watch cardinality — route+model+variant+deploy_id can explode dashboards. We should rollup at route+model and allow drilldowns for variant.
Lia Gomez: Product: Console needs single chart with selectable percentile lines and a drop-down to switch as route-level vs model-level. Also show current rollout tag.
Alex Chen: Agreed on rollup. Proposal: metrics names & labels:

```
redwood_runtime_request_latency_seconds{route="/chat",model="rwkv-13b",percentile="p95"}
redwood_runtime_ttft_ms{route,model}
redwood_runtime_tokens_per_sec{route,model}
```

and a summary series at route/model granularity using `deploy_id` only for drilldown.
Priya Nair: For Prometheus/TSDB queries, suggest these example queries:

```
# P95 latency per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
# tokens/sec
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_tokens_total[1m])) by (route, model)
# TTFT p50
quantile_over_time(0.5, redwood_runtime_ttft_ms[5m]) by (route, model)
```

Marco Ruiz: We can emit counters `redwood_runtime_tokens_total` and a distribution for latency. We'll need ops to add `route` label at ingress if not present.
Samira Patel: Alerts: propose firing when P95 latency > 300ms for hosted tier, > 500ms for dedicated. Also when tokens/sec per GPU drops 40% vs baseline.
Lia Gomez: UX: show small sparkline for tokens/sec and a "degraded" badge when any SLO breached. Also a "compare vs baseline" toggle.
Alex Chen: Data retention & rollups: raw 1s resolution for 1d, 1m aggregated for 30d. That should keep storage sane.
Priya Nair: Telemetry pipeline note: ingest team — we need route label enrichment at edge, and a new job to materialize p50/p95/p99 per 5m to avoid heavy on-read cost.
infra-bot: CI job queued: telemetry/metrics-schema#274 will validate new metric names.
Marco Ruiz: I'll add the telemetry emitters in runtime this week. Will push PR for label changes — need help from eng-infra for multi-cluster labels.
Samira Patel: I'll draft alerting rules and runbooks. Assigning: Samira -> alerts, Marco -> runtime emits, Priya -> query templates + dashboard panels, Alex -> Console embedding + rollout UX.
Alex Chen: Action item: sync tomorrow 10am PT, 30min. Agenda: metric names, cardinality limits, dashboard proto. @Lia @Priya @Marco pls RSVP.
Lia Gomez: RSVP'd :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: can do
Marco Ruiz: yep
Samira Patel: will be there
deploy-bot: new meeting created: "SLO Observability Canvas" 2025-06-18 10:00 PT
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — capturing notes in #eng-platform wiki after meeting.
